description: Simulated data with a factor regressor f declared in the order d, b, a, c; every response has a planted split at z1 = 5 (z2 is noise): gaussian y_gauss and binary y_bin (factor stay, leave) on x and f, cell means y_cell on f, and y_mean (gaussian) and y_count (poisson) on the split alone.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 600L
    lev <- c("d", "b", "a", "c")
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), f = factor(sample(lev, n, replace = TRUE), levels = lev), z1 = runif(n, 
        0, 10), z2 = rnorm(n))
    left <- d$z1 <= 5
    fl <- as.character(d$f)
    eff_left <- c(d = 0, b = 1, a = -1, c = 0.5)[fl]
    eff_right <- c(d = 0, b = -1, a = 1.5, c = -0.5)[fl]
    e <- rnorm(n)
    d$y_gauss <- unname(ifelse(left, 1 + 1.5 * d$x + eff_left, -0.5 + 0.5 * d$x + eff_right)) + e
    eta <- unname(ifelse(left, -0.5 + d$x + eff_left, 0.5 - d$x + eff_right))
    d$y_bin <- factor(ifelse(runif(n) < plogis(eta), "leave", "stay"), levels = c("stay", "leave"))
    d$y_cell <- unname(ifelse(left, c(d = 1, b = 2, a = 0, c = 3)[fl], c(d = -1, b = 0, a = 2, c = 1)[fl])) + 
        rnorm(n)
    d$y_mean <- ifelse(left, 1, -1) + rnorm(n)
    d$y_count <- rpois(n, exp(ifelse(left, 0.3, 1.2)))
    d
}
